name: Shanazar Nizamaddinov
title: Backend Engineer
tagline: I build backend systems and the LLM and RAG services that run on top of them.
description: Shanazar Nizamaddinov is a backend engineer who builds backend systems and LLM-based applications with Python/Django and PHP/Symfony.
about: I'm a backend engineer with a degree in Computer Engineering and a minor in Mathematics. I have been building backend systems since 2021, mostly in Python/Django and PHP/Symfony, and these days much of my work is on LLM and RAG applications. I am happiest when the work keeps me close to the terminal.

I also like running servers myself. I host my own services on a home server, and one of my favourite repositories on GitHub is [Awesome-Selfhosted](https://github.com/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted).
Away from the keyboard I run, play football and enjoy filmmaking. I'm a huge fan of The Office and Succession, and I like reading blogs such as [Idle Words](https://idlewords.com/).
